_about: SAN-1321 — expected public.mastra_* schema for the MDE production feature contract, plus the @mastra/core + @mastra/pg pairing that produces it.
_derivation: The expectedTables list is the public.mastra_* set MDE's runtime and production feature contract require (32 tables), verified against production project zkwcbyxiwklihegjhuql on 2026-09-18. adapterVersion/coreVersion record the certified pairing (SAN-1338): @mastra/pg@1.29.0 with @mastra/core@1.74.0. A fresh `npm run mastra:init` with that adapter creates 43 tables — the 32 below plus adapterInitExtraTables, which back Mastra features MDE does not use. Runtime proof (SAN-1338): a real thread, messages, a thread-scoped working-memory write, and a suspended workflow run on scratch Postgres touched only mastra_threads, mastra_messages, and mastra_workflow_snapshot (mastra_thread_state stayed empty), so production's 32-table set is sufficient and no schema migration is required.
_why: src/mastra/lib/storage.ts runs PostgresStore with disableInit: true, so nothing self-heals at runtime. A fresh environment provisioned with a mis-paired adapter would silently miss most of this schema. This file is the contract; scripts/check-mastra-schema-contract.mjs reports drift between it and the installed packages.
_maintenance: When @mastra/core / @mastra/pg are upgraded, run `npm run mastra:init` against a scratch Postgres, diff the resulting public.mastra_* set against expectedTables plus adapterInitExtraTables, and classify every difference: prove whether the upgraded runtime reads/writes it on a normal agent, memory, or workflow path. If it does and production lacks it, a production-safe migration is a prerequisite — do not extend expectedTables merely to make the checker pass. Update adapterVersion/coreVersion (and the table lists only when the required or adapter-created set genuinely changes) in one commit.
